levels.surface: عدة، من أبناء أصحاب رسول الله

notes: «عدة، من أبناء أصحاب رسول الله» is a group the text does not name: unnamed link.
«آبائهم» (their fathers) is collective and named only by relation to the group: relation link.
«دنية» is read as the name of the last transmitter, the one who relays the Prophet's words; the text gives no further detail, so this reading rests on the text alone.
